headline: Approved $200 sponsorship of a Sound of Music movie night to fund a Baines student trip to Europe.
summary: A choir teacher asked for help with a 2028 student trip to Europe. Students plan a movie night showing The Sound of Music to raise money for bus fare to and from Boston Logan. Members agreed to cover the $200 licensing cost so ticket money goes to the trip.
decisions: Approved $200 sponsorship of a Sound of Music movie night to fund a Baines student trip to Europe.
discussion: Poet laureate guidelines: Members said the next poet laureate needs set expectations, such as required appearances. They discussed whether a candidate who attended the meeting fits the role.
Downtown Live ticket sales: Members reviewed strong member sales and upcoming shows. They also discussed a lighting problem that bothered people in the balcony.
Traffic box artwork: Members discussed repainting boxes and taking photos of painted boxes for a file. They also said they would not use one artist again after a hard phone call.
Heart art pieces: Members talked about ordering the resin hearts in bulk to save on shipping. They discussed placing them at more sites around the city.

decision_evidence.quote: All those in favor of funding this initiative? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? No, okay. I'm going to ask for the anonymous consent. Theresa, we will fund your push for the viewing.

decision_titles: $200 sponsorship of Sound of Music movie fundraiser

problems.what: the minutes don't say how the motion ended near the quote
